# Carla Jardim

Carla Jardim has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 6](https://flow.je/elections/district-6), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/20/reform-jersey-complete-bid-to-take-st-helier-south/)\]
